phaseName: Shell Interactions: Menus, Spotlight, Launchpad, Control Center, Spaces
goal: Make the shell fully interactive: working global menus, Spotlight, Launchpad, Control Center (dark-mode toggle wired system-wide), Spaces, and complete window behaviors.
summary: Phase 2 complete: Shell fully interactive — menus, Spotlight, Launchpad, Control Center, Spaces, and complete window behaviors. Step 1: Data-driven menu system — appMenuRegistry (defaultMenus with File/Edit/View/Window/Help, action keys + shortcuts, registerAppMenus/getAppMenus for per-app overrides); MenuBar rewritten with Apple menu (About/System Settings/Dark Mode/Lock Screen + separators), data-driven app menus, handler-map activate(), Esc closes, aria-disabled, shortcut rendering; useWindows extended with closeFocused/minimizeFocused/toggleZoom. 8 E2E tests. Step 2: Spotlight (Cmd+Space toggle, app search, arrow-key navigation, Enter launches, document-level Esc listener) + Launchpad (full-screen glass grid, click-to-launch, Esc closes, F4 shortcut) + Dock Launchpad icon. 6 E2E tests. Step 3: Shared desktopStore (useSyncExternalStore managing theme/wallpaper/brightness/wifi/bluetooth, 5 wallpaper presets, localStorage persistence, initDesktopState); ControlCenter (Dark Mode tile wired to store flipping [data-theme], Wi-Fi/Bluetooth pills, brightness slider, wallpaper picker, backdrop-filter, Esc closes); Spaces (Mission Control overlay, add-space, active selection, Esc closes, F3 shortcut); MenuBar gained Control Center + Spaces icon buttons. 9 E2E tests. Step 4: Window behaviors — resize handle (bottom-right corner, pointer-event drag, min 320x200), minimize-to-dock (scaled thumbnails in minimized-tray with restore + close), focus z-order (is-focused class), isInteracting state (user-select/pointer-events during drag). 6 E2E tests. Cross-step fixes: minimized-tray pointer-events:auto (desktop was intercepting), Spotlight document-level Esc listener, test selectors scoped to .window-frame[data-app] to distinguish from minimized thumbnails. Full suite: `npx playwright test` → 34 passed; `npx vitest run` → 8 passed; `npm run build` → exit 0 (48 modules).

gateVerdicts.evidence: Step 1: `npx playwright test menus` → 8 passed; Step 2: `npx playwright test spotlight-launchpad` → 6 passed; Step 3: `npx playwright test control-center` → 9 passed; Step 4: `npx playwright test windows` → 6 passed. Full suite `npx playwright test` → 34 passed (9.8s). `npx vitest run` → 8 passed. All real browser-based E2E + unit tests.
gateVerdicts.rationale: All four steps used real Playwright E2E verification launching browsers against the built app, asserting interactive behavior (menu clicks, keyboard shortcuts, drag/resize via mouse, theme toggles, state persistence). No proxy or sentinel checks.

gateVerdicts.evidence: MenuBar renders Apple + File/Edit/View/Window/Help menus with working actions; Spotlight opens via Cmd+Space and launches apps; Launchpad shows app grid and launches; Control Center Dark Mode flips [data-theme] system-wide + persists; Spaces opens with add/switch; windows drag/resize/minimize-to-dock/restore/close all work. `npx playwright test` → 34 passed.
gateVerdicts.rationale: Phase goal was a fully interactive shell with working menus, Spotlight, Launchpad, Control Center, Spaces, and complete window behaviors — all delivered and verified by the full E2E suite. Every shell interaction from the success criteria is exercised: dock launch, Apple menu + app menus, Control Center Dark Mode toggle, Spotlight Cmd+Space, Launchpad, window open/move/minimize/close/resize.

gateVerdicts.evidence: Per-app menu customization (registerAppMenus) is available but no apps register custom menus yet — deferred to Phase 3+ when apps are built. Spotlight searches apps only (note/filename search deferred to when Notes/ Finder exist). System Settings app not yet built (Apple menu launches it but app not registered).
gateVerdicts.rationale: Nothing deferred beyond what the plan explicitly assigns to later phases. Per-app custom menus and note/filename search in Spotlight are Phase 3+ work (app framework + apps). The System Settings app is Phase 3-5. No unplanned gaps in Phase 2's scope.
